provenance.sourceNote: L6 one-card slice (U13) cross-metric coincidence rule for the gut-brain pair. The brain carries a synthesised edge gut_comfort_score|correlates|mood_score (real A8 run, U10) grounded in the gut-brain-axis literature; the engine scopes coincidence rules to brain-neighbour pairs at runtime (C10), so this rule only ever fires when that edge is SERVABLE. The edge is a symmetric `correlates` (context-only, no direction), so both leaves test the same-day rising co-movement and the lag is null (same window ≡ C10 lag 0) rather than a directed next-day horizon.
